script: Your ChatGPT account could have been secretly taken over. A critical new exploit just exposed millions of users to potential data theft. Security researchers found a flaw in OpenAI’s system. It wasn't a password guess, but a gap in how account session tokens were handled. Attackers could trick the system, gaining access to your active session. This bypassed your password entirely, giving them full control. This vulnerability exposed chat history, personal data, and even payment info. Imagine strangers reading your private AI conversations. OpenAI has patched it. But remember: use strong, unique passwords and enable two-factor authentication to protect your digital life.
